description: Liste des nœuds de raccordement optique THD64 is a dataset listed in Open-Data La Fibre64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by La Fibre 64. Liste des nœuds de raccordement optique (NRO) du réseau d'initiative publique très haut débit porté par le Syndicat Mixte Ouvert La Fibre 64 (le Syndicat a été créé par le Département des Pyrénées-Atlantiques et les dix intercommunalités du territoire). Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Aménagement numérique. Its keywords are NRO, FTTH, Fibre, Très haut débit, Télécom. The portal shows 63 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lafibre64-fr-portal.
